folder.title: Where is the project?
folder.lead: Pick a folder you already have, clone one, or start empty. Crewyard reads it to suggest commands.
folder.pickEmpty: Choose or create an empty folder
folder.existingText: Found .mission/project.json; the steps start from it.
folder.addedText: This folder is already in Crewyard. Creating it again rewrites its settings.
folder.notEmpty: This folder is not empty. Its files stay as they are.
folder.gitMissing: Git is not installed on this machine.
folder.gitParent: Inside another repository ({{path}}). Choose that repository's top folder instead.
folder.gitInit: Run git init when I create the project
folder.gitInitOn: not a repository yet; git init runs when you create the project
folder.gitNone: not a repository. Tick the box to run git init on create.
folder.name: Name
folder.pathOk: longest path in a worktree: {{count}} of {{limit}} characters
folder.pathTooLong: longest path in a worktree: {{count}} of {{limit}} characters. Turn on Windows long paths or choose a shorter worktree folder.
folder.pathLongOn: longest path in a worktree: {{count}} characters; Windows long paths are on
folder.pathTruncated: Stopped after {{count}} files, so a longer path may exist.
folder.noRemote: none yet, set it up in step 6

type.unknown: Not recognized; add the commands yourself

clone.title: Your repositories
clone.signedOut: GitHub CLI is not signed in. Run gh auth login in a terminal, then come back.
clone.note: Cloning downloads the repository now. Crewyard writes its own settings only when you create the project.

agents.title: Which agents may work here?
agents.lead: Only installed agents can be allowed. Conformance checks have not run on this machine yet, so none of them is marked as checked.

budget.title: Accounts and budget
budget.lead: Crew proposals only pick from the profiles you allow here. Paid fallbacks never go past these caps.
budget.noProfiles: No profiles on this machine yet. The project is saved with none allowed; allow them once you add profiles on the Providers screen.
budget.note: Caps apply to API-key spend. Subscription plans are watched through their own usage windows.

rules.title: Rules for this project
rules.lead: Every rule is stored in .mission/project.json without secrets. You can change them later.
rules.fallback: When an agent hits a limit

fallbackHint.manual: The task waits; you choose what happens next.
fallbackHint.ask: Crewyard proposes a backup agent and waits for your answer.
fallbackHint.auto: The backup agent takes over and the handoff is recorded.

rules.slotsHint: 1 to 16 agents at once in this project.
rules.commandsHint: Only inside the agent's worktree. Everything else asks first.
rules.toastsHint: Only low-risk commands can ever be approved from a notification.

github.title: GitHub
github.lead: Crewyard uses your gh sign-in. Agents commit locally; pushes wait for you.
github.ghSignedOut: gh is not signed in; run gh auth login in a terminal
github.createRepo: Create a private repository on GitHub
github.noRemoteSignIn: no remote yet; sign in with gh to create one
github.noRemoteGit: no remote yet; the folder needs git first (step 1)
github.createOn: a private repository under {{user}} is created with the project; nothing is pushed
github.createOff: no remote yet. Tick the box to create a private repository.
github.pushesText: wait for my approval, one push per finished change
github.ciText: add .github/workflows/ci.yml: ubuntu, push on the main branch only, concurrency, timeouts, no schedule
github.ciExists: ci.yml already exists and is left as it is
github.ciNoCommands: needs a build or test command (step 1)
github.actionsText: % of the monthly quota before a warning

worktree.title: How should task worktrees start?
worktree.lead: Each task works in its own git worktree, which starts without node_modules, .env files or caches. Prepare it here.
worktree.setupHint: Runs in each new worktree before the agent starts. A failed step stops the start and shows its last lines.
worktree.cleanupHint: Runs before Crewyard removes or parks a worktree. If a step fails, the worktree stays.

problem.command: One program and its arguments. Pipes, && and redirection need a script file.
problem.timeout: Timeout must be a whole number from 1 to 3600 seconds.

worktree.includeHint: Gitignored files or folders, listed by name. They are copied, never linked, and their contents are never logged.
worktree.includeCapHint: Entries past this total are skipped.
worktree.includeNone: Nothing is copied. Add .env or a cache folder if the project needs it to build.

entry.not_ignored: tracked by git, so the worktree already has it
entry.link: a link or junction; never copied

worktree.portHint: Each branch gets its own port from a range, so dev servers in parallel tasks do not collide.
worktree.portVarText: setup and agents get {{name}} and CREWYARD_PORT
worktree.note: Setup and cleanup commands are high risk. Each one is approved once in the Inbox; changing its text asks again.
